# Butter Sun (`butter-sun`)

Style of `professional-apple-ui`. Pick ONE per project, record it in the project's `AGENTS.md` (`UI style: butter-sun`) and in `docs/ui-style.json`, and generate `Theme.swift` from it; never mix styles.

**Feel**: Cheerful and bright: butter-yellow hero with dark button text, extra-round cards.

**Source of the values**: **computed**: generated by `make_style.py` from the brand hue with the OKLCH recipe calibrated on Mint Studio, then pushed until every reading pair reaches WCAG AA.

## Type and shape

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Font design | `rounded` |
| Corner radii (hero / card / tile / thumbnail) | 32 / 26 / 18 / 14 pt |
| Role hues (OKLCH) | brand 91°, info 236°, plan 290°, attention 45°, danger 25° |
